title: MPBL South Finals: Cabañero, Rocacurva rally Biñan but fall vs. Quezon
summary: Cebuano standouts Nic Cabañero and Kenny Roger Rocacurva sparked a spirited comeback by Biñan Tatak Gel, but their efforts fell short as the Lagunenses bowed to the Quezon Huskers, 81-67, in Game 3…

blocks.text: Cebuano standouts Nic Cabañero and Kenny Roger Rocacurva sparked a spirited comeback by Biñan Tatak Gel, but their efforts fell short as the Lagunenses bowed to the Quezon Huskers, 81-67, in Game 3 of the SportsPlus Maharlika Pilipinas Basketball League (MPBL) 2026 South Division Finals on Wednesday at the packed Alonte Sports Arena in Binan, Laguna....
